user.title: Connect neoom BEAAM
user.description:
Enter the IP address of your BEAAM and the API key.

You can find the API key at **connect.neoom.com → API keys → key for BEAAM API**.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate neoom BEAAM
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {host} is no longer accepted. Create a new one at **connect.neoom.com → API keys** and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure neoom BEAAM
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address if your BEAAM received a new one. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the BEAAM. Check the IP address.
error.wrong_device: A different BEAAM answered at this address. Set it up as its own integration.

abort.reauth_successful: The new API key was applied.
abort.reauth_failed: The integration entry could not be found.
abort.reconfigure_failed: The integration entry could not be found.
